lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-luminance, roughly circular pixel clusters arranged in approximately four horizontal rows on the mid-lateral flank, with a higher density of clusters located posterior to the pectoral fin and ventral to the first dorsal fin.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical alignments of high-luminance spots forming periodic columns that intersect horizontal rows, visible primarily in the mid-flank region where intensity contrast is highest.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent linear feature exhibiting a high-contrast luminance gradient (light superior, dark inferior) extending horizontally along the upper third of the flank from the mid-body to the caudal peduncle.
